entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appellant
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand .... Respondent
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Navneet Kumar
 For the Appellant : Mr. Rishi Pallav, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Shailesh Kr Sinha, App
 -----
5/19.05.2023

Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant and learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
IA No.07 of 2023 2.
The legal aid defence counsel appointed by the JHALSA submitted that the IA No.07 of 2023 has been filed on behalf of the appellant to condone the delay of 172 days as pointed out by the office.

3. Learned defence counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant submitted that the appellant is a poor and illiterate man, who was not aware of passing the impugned judgement of conviction dated 31.01.2020 and order of sentence dated 06.02.2020, passed by learned District & Additional Sessions Judge - III - Cum - Special Judge (POCSO), Gumla in (POCSO) G.R. Case No. 122/2017,
arising out of Bharno P.S. Case No. 09/2017 dated 05.02.2017, whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted under Section 376 of the I.P.C. and further not found guilty under section 4, 8, 12 of POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment of 7 years (Seven years) with fine of Rs. 5,000/- u/s 376 of I.P.C. and in default of payment of fine, he shall further undergo S.I. for two months.
4.

It has further been pointed out that when the counsel has been appointed by JHALSA, as legal aid counsel and thus this appeal has been preferred and therefore the delay has been caused and it is submitted that there is no willful default on the part of the appellant 2 Cr. Appeal (SJ) No. 837 of 2022 and he would suffer irreparable loss, if the delay in filing the criminal appeal is not condoned.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned APP appearing on behalf of the State submitted that the appellant is in jail and this appeal has been filed through JHALSA by providing the legal aid defence counsel to the appellant.

6. Having taken into consideration the aforesaid facts and submission advanced on behalf of the appellant and the cause shown in the interlocutory application, the delay in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.
7. IA No.07 of 2023 is accordingly allowed.
8. Defect No.8 pointed out by the office is ignored for the present.
9. This appeal is admitted for hearing.

10. Let the scanned copy of the lower court records be called for from the court below concerned and put up this case immediately after receipt of the lower court .
11.
Let this appeal be listed along with criminal revision No. 1101 of 2017 on 10th July 2023.

( Navneet Kumar, J.) R.Kumar Soma Oraon vs The State Of Jharkhand on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93808527/
